item.title: 3.10 Governance
item.description:
Implementation phase

This clause is implemented in Phase 4: Governance. View the full implementation roadmap

1. Clause Overview

Governance is the framework that brings all the preceding clauses together and ensures responsible development, deployment, and management across the AI system lifecycle. If the policy (3.1) sets the principles and license obligations (3.5) and the AI SBOM (3.9) create individual processes, governance manages them so that they work consistently even as regulations change and models are replaced.

item.title: Governance: Management Organization and Approval System
item.description:
Where this page fits

Governance is the foundation of open source management. The identification, use approval, and management stages work only after you decide who is responsible, who reviews, and who approves. The FSEC guide also covers the composition and roles of the management organization separately, before the management procedures.

Documents produced here: an open source policy, a list of roles and responsibilities, and records of role assignments.

Where does financial sector governance start?

The “Guide to Using and Managing Open Source Software in the Financial Sector” (금융분야 오픈소스 소프트웨어 활용·관리 안내서; Financial Supervisory Service (금융감독원) and Financial Security Institute (금융보안원), 2022, hereafter the FSEC guide) presents the composition and operation of the management organization and examples of roles. ISO/IEC 5230 requires these as verification materials: a documented policy (3.1.1.1), a list of roles and responsibilities (3.1.2.1), identification of the people in each role (3.2.2.1), and a method for accessing legal expertise (3.2.2.3). Governance is the activity that produces these verification materials.
